lines: That was idle talk, and I would know.
I have heard better ideas from people talking in their sleep.
If you came to help, you missed the part where you help.
You walked in carrying trouble and somehow forgot the useful part.
I may be between jobs, but at least I am not between thoughts.
The village has enough chores without cleaning up after your mouth.
You keep acting important. Has anyone else noticed yet?
If foolishness made noise, you would drown out the bell.
Do not confuse my free time with patience for you.
Your confidence is <shake>louder</shake> than anything you have to say.
I have spent whole afternoons doing nothing more useful than this conversation.
You could lend a hand, but I doubt you would know which one.
Nobody asked for your opinion. That did not slow you down at all.
I would rather sort spoiled seeds than hear that again.
You make a simple task feel like a village emergency.
Even I know when to stop standing around and leave.
The broom has done more for this village today.
You arrived empty-handed and still managed to make extra work.
Try speaking after the thought is finished next time.
I have no trade, and somehow I still have better business here than you.
Your manners need work. For once, I hope you find some.
If I wanted useless noise, I would kick an empty bucket.
You make waiting for work sound productive by comparison.
The square was calmer before you decided to improve it.
Go bother someone who is paid to listen.
